question: After the no-op pacing blocker is fixed, should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Both queue states are defensible: pending preserves future recoverability, while failed gives operators a clearer terminal state; tests cannot choose that product/operations tradeoff.

options.title: Accept Pending Deferral After Repair
options.body: Merge after the pacing fix if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter entries to stay recoverable until adapter reconciliation or operator surfacing exists.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery-ledger work is designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a doctor, UI, or API surface before allowing ambiguous entries to remain pending longer after upgrade.

recommendation.title: Accept Pending Deferral After Repair
recommendation.body: Merge after the pacing fix if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter entries to stay recoverable until adapter reconciliation or operator surfacing exists.
